description: This file contains functions for mapping booking data to mutation input objects, including handling recurring bookings, and imports various utility functions and types related to bookings and date parsing.

methods.name: mapBookingToMutationInput
methods.description: Maps booking options to a mutation input object, including processing search parameters and date formatting.

methods.name: mapRecurringBookingToMutationInput
methods.description: Generates multiple recurring booking mutation inputs based on a single booking and recurring count, assigning unique IDs and date calculations.
